title: Part Library search, filters, sorting and columns still work
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST-01, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib list Alpha") has no manufacturer and is in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered).
  • Part Library entry {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST-02, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL lib list Bravo") has no manufacturer and is in category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered).
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBLIST).
  • At least one manufacturer, {Manufacturer-A}, exists in the Manufacturer filter.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Read the column headers.
  3. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  4. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-A}.
  5. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  6. Open the Manufacturer filter and pick {Manufacturer-A}.
  7. Open the Manufacturer filter and pick All manufacturers.
  8. Click the Description column header.
  9. Click the Description column header again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The columns are Description, Part Number, Tags, Category, Manufacturer, Measurement and Size, the same set as on the earlier build.
  • Step 3: Search works: {Part-A} and {Part-B} are listed (2 rows).
  • Step 4: The Category filter works: only {Part-A} is listed.
  • Step 5: Both are listed again.
  • Step 6: The Manufacturer filter works: neither entry is listed, because neither has a manufacturer.
  • Step 7: Both are listed again.
  • Steps 8 and 9: Sorting works: the entries are ordered by Description, and the second click reverses the order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-R5, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), board 7.0 (Before: the Catalog page today), 13 Oct copy.
